annotations.title: Assess a cross-border payment route before paying

description: Prices a cross-border payment before the business commits to it: every known route for the pair, assessed on SwapEazi's independent data. Returns deterministic JSON: the routes known for the pair, each cost and FX figure with its source, read time, freshness (fresh, aging, stale, unknown) and evidence type (observed, executable, indicative, published; the official rate as reference), settlement facts, the requirements on record with sources, what changed since the last assessment of the corridor, data-quality flags (stale, contradictory, missing, indicative only), unknowns, and the evidence behind each finding, under an assessment_id whose record is kept and retrievable (GET /api/v1/route-assessments/{id}; a content hash, not a signature). Never ranks a route as advice, never executes, never claims a figure is executable unless a provider's firm quote is on record. Free; same as GET /api/v1/route-assessments.

amount.description: Amount leaving, in the source currency. Optional: without it the corridor is assessed at about USD 10,000, labelled.

as_of.description: Assessment time, ISO 8601, within 15 minutes of now (default now). A past assessment is retrieved by assessment_id, never recomputed.

assessment_id.description: Retrieve a kept assessment record instead of making a new one.

beneficiary_country.description: Two-letter country of the beneficiary's account; with payer_country for a same-currency payment.

charge_option.description: Who pays the banks' charges on a wire: OUR (payer pays all), SHA (shared), BEN (beneficiary).

corridor.description: Instead of from and to: e.g. EUR-ZMW.

exclude_types.description: Leave out routes of these rail types. Each route left out is listed with the reason.

from.description: Source currency, ISO code, e.g. EUR.

include_types.description: Keep only routes of these rail types. Each route left out is listed with the reason.

min_answer_rate.description: Percent, 0 to 100: leave out routes whose measured 7-day answer rate is lower, or not measured (not enough reads). Each is listed with the reason.

payer_country.description: Two-letter country the money leaves from. Needed when from and to are the same currency (e.g. USD from LR to a USD account in CN): the payment is then assessed as a cross-border transfer, banks' charges and rules, no conversion.

sort.description: Your chosen order for the routes: landed cost against the official rate, stated days to land, or the measured 7-day answer rate. It is your order, stated as yours; SwapEazi does not rank routes.

to.description: Destination currency, ISO code, e.g. ZMW.

name: assess_route
title: Assess a cross-border payment route before paying
